skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting numerators of fractions with identical denominators.

skills.name: Common Denominator Conversion
skills.definition: Finding a common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Operations
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer/whole-number parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Regrouping and Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole-number part to the fraction part when the fraction subtraction results in a negative value.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the final fractional part to its lowest terms.
